Name: Eliezer, Son of Dodavah
Summary: Eliezer, son of Dodavah of Mareshah, prophesied against Jehoshaphat for joining with Ahaziah, and the ships built for Tarshish were broken.
KeyStory: Because Jehoshaphat joined himself with Ahaziah, Eliezer declared the LORD had broken his works, and the ships could not go to Tarshish.
LifeLesson: An alliance with the wicked can wreck even a well-built enterprise.
